springboard.title: Springboard Cybersecurity
info: Completed a 50-lab cybersecurity analyst curriculum covering host hardening, network security, IAM, cryptography, SecOps, application-security testing, cloud risk, and vulnerability assessment.
Delivered a guided penetration-test capstone spanning reconnaissance, target scanning, vulnerability identification, threat assessment, and security reporting.

24g.title: Software Development Intern
info: Delivered four Vue.js expo interfaces as the sole frontend developer for Salesforce, Waymo, and Essilor Luxottica, coordinating with the Experiential Team Lead to take each interface from mockup to production.
Designed and implemented custom page transitions beyond the supplied mockups for Oakley’s Vue.js interface, coordinating with the design team to adapt supporting assets.

Delivered the frontend for an Oakley expo activation that Essilor Luxottica named its favorite of four event experiences and expressed intent to reuse with better placement to increase visibility and participation.
Owned Campaign Manager’s reporting interface and contributed to its API integration. The internal event-reporting tool remained in active company use after the internship.

description.short: An interactive photo experience with athlete selection, custom animated transitions, coordinated video and camera sequences, and QR codes for downloading the finished image.
long: As the sole frontend developer, I constructed the interface from supplied visual mockups and owned its interactive design and API integration.

I requested separate assets from the design team in order to animate elements embedded in the supplied assets. I used them in staggered animations during transitions and interactions, making the background artwork part of how the interface responded to user actions.
Essilor Luxottica named Oakley its favorite of the four experiences at the event and expressed interest in using it again with more prominent placement.

description.short: An internal dashboard for reviewing event and activation data through social, lead, and interaction reports, with filters, pagination, and CSV exports.
long: I took ownership of most of Campaign Manager’s frontend while working with the other interns at 24G. I built the reporting interface and integrated the team’s APIs, contributing to a tool that remained in active company use after my internship.

The download flow gave me room to shape an interaction within an otherwise established interface. I used sliding file entries and an animated completion checkmark to show when the application was preparing a report and when the file was ready.
